name: ti-recon
description: Passive external threat-intelligence investigation of URLs, domains, IP addresses, file hashes and user-selected local files, with each analyst's own provider credentials. Bundles the local TI Recon MCP server and the TI Recon analyst Skill.

virustotal_api_key.title: Google TI / VirusTotal API key
virustotal_api_key.description: Optional. Enables Google Threat Intelligence. Leave empty if you do not have one: the source is then reported as not_configured and is never asked.

urlscan_api_key.title: urlscan.io API key
urlscan_api_key.description: Optional. Enables urlscan.io passive web intelligence. Leave empty if you do not have one.

greynoise_api_key.title: GreyNoise API key
greynoise_api_key.description: Optional. Enables GreyNoise internet-scanner context for IPv4 addresses. Leave empty if you do not have one.

censys_pat.title: Censys personal access token (PAT)
censys_pat.description: Optional. Enables Censys Platform exposure context. This is the Platform API v3 personal access token, not the older API ID / secret pair. Leave empty if you do not have one.

abusech_auth_key.title: abuse.ch Auth-Key
abusech_auth_key.description: Optional. One key enables all three abuse.ch sources: ThreatFox, URLhaus and MalwareBazaar. Leave empty if you do not have one.

hybrid_analysis_api_key.title: Hybrid Analysis API key
hybrid_analysis_api_key.description: Optional. Enables passive lookup of existing Hybrid Analysis sandbox reports by file hash. Nothing is ever submitted or detonated. Leave empty if you do not have one.

censys_organization_id.title: Censys organization ID (optional)
censys_organization_id.description: Not a secret. Only for Censys organization accounts: selects the organization credit endpoint. Leave empty for a personal Censys account or if Censys is not configured.
